title: Design doc, plan or proposal
when_to_use: A document that asks reviewers to approve a plan or choose between options.
facts_hint: paste the constraints, costs and dates the plan must respect

personas.description: Approver who reads the document once before a review meeting and decides whether to approve, ask for changes, or reject.
Engineer who will carry out the plan and reads it to find what is unclear or risky.

dimensions.name: The decision asked
dimensions.question: Can the approver say what decision is asked of them after the first section?

anchors.3: a decision is implied but not stated
anchors.5: the first section states the decision asked, the options and the recommendation

dimensions.name: Options
dimensions.question: Are the alternatives compared on the same criteria?

anchors.3: alternatives are listed but not compared
anchors.5: two or more options are compared on the same named criteria, with the cost of each

dimensions.name: Risks
dimensions.question: Are the main risks named with how each is detected and handled?

anchors.3: risks are named without detection or handling
anchors.5: each main risk is named with how it is detected and what happens then

dimensions.name: Plan
dimensions.question: Can the implementer start from the plan without a meeting?

anchors.5: steps with an owner, a date and a check that the step is done
